What the record says

  • The Chargers' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is favored by 7 to 9.5 (since 2002): 34-15-1 against the spread, a 69.4% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is favored by 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 31-43-2, 41.9%.
